title: Citation gap
content: A citation gap exists when your page ranks on the first page of regular search results for a query and the AI answer for that query cites other sources and leaves your domain out.

meta.why: A ranking report can look healthy while the AI answer on the same results page sends readers to other sites.
meta.example: A site ranks on the first page for 40 queries that show an AI answer, and its domain is missing from 26 of those answers, a citation gap rate of 65%.
meta.check: Count the first-page queries where the AI answer leaves your domain out, divide by the first-page queries that showed an AI answer, and multiply by 100 to get a citation gap rate.
meta.limitation: We define the citation gap this way for our own reports, and another tool can set the ranking cutoff at a different position. AI answers change between runs, so sample each query more than once.
meta.sources: Animalz: AEO glossary | https://animalz.co/blog/aeo-glossary | Industry glossary
